gallery.title: Design system gallery
gallery.sampleBody: Interface text: clear, readable, no technical jargon.

nav.label: Main navigation
nav.logoutFailed: Sign-out not confirmed by the server: close the browser if you are on a shared computer.

shell.placeholder: This section comes with the next part.
shell.resetBanner: The administrator started a reset of your password on {{date}}. If you didn't ask for it, contact them.
shell.error: Can't reach the server. Check the connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

setup.title: Initial setup
setup.intro: Create the administrator account. You find the setup code in the server start-up logs.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the email of your account.
forgot.sent: If the address is registered, we sent you an email with instructions.
forgot.noSmtp: Email is not configured: ask the administrator for a password reset link.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Password updated: you can now sign in.

invite.title: Welcome
invite.intro: You were invited as {{username}} ({{email}}). Choose a password to get started.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.required: Two-step verification is mandatory for administrators: set it up to continue.
totp.step1: Scan the code with an authenticator app (for example Aegis, Raivo, 1Password).
totp.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows now.
totp.step3: Save these recovery codes: each works once if you lose your phone.

errors.challenge_expired: Time is up: sign in again.
errors.setup_not_needed: The initial setup has already been done.
errors.token_expired: This link has expired: ask for a new one.
errors.password_weak: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
errors.totp_mandatory: Two-step verification is mandatory for administrators.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts: wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.history_window: That moment is outside the available history.
errors.pairing_closed: This request is no longer valid.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.newCodes: New recovery codes: the old ones no longer work.

types.admin_reset: Password reset started by the administrator

overview.title: Overview
overview.spaceWarning: Storage almost full: free some space or ask the administrator to raise the quota.
overview.noVaults: No vaults yet. The first one is created from Obsidian, with the plugin.

device.title: Devices
device.name: Name
device.revokeText: The device stops syncing right away. Files already on the device are not deleted.

pairing.title: Add a device
pairing.intro: Scan the code with the camera of the new device, where Obsidian and the plugin are already installed in an empty vault.
pairing.qrAlt: QR code to link a device
pairing.requestHint: Approve only if you see the same code on the new device. If it wasn't you, deny.
pairing.expired: Code expired: generate a new one.
pairing.closed: This request is no longer valid.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.choose: Choose a conflict from the list.
conflicts.summaryEdit: Edited on {{mineDevice}} ({{mine}}) and on {{device}} ({{incoming}}). Both versions are saved.
conflicts.summaryCreated: Two files with the same name created on {{mineDevice}} ({{mine}}) and on {{device}} ({{incoming}}). Both are saved.
conflicts.doneMine: You kept your version. The one from {{device}} stays in the history.
conflicts.doneIncoming: You kept the version from {{device}}. Yours stays in the history.
conflicts.doneBoth: You kept both: yours is saved as a separate file.
conflicts.stale: A newer version arrived: check again before choosing.
conflicts.gone: This conflict has already been resolved.
conflicts.unsavedMerge: Your merge was not saved: here it is, you can copy it.

history.title: History of {{path}}
history.restoreHint: It becomes the current version; the current one stays in the history.
history.trashHint: Deleted files stay here for at least 7 days.

vaultSettings.name: Vault name
vaultSettings.retentionHint: How many days to keep previous versions (up to {{max}}).
vaultSettings.zipHint: You can pick a moment from {{from}} on.
vaultSettings.deleteText: The vault is permanently deleted from the server, history and trash included: the encrypted data becomes unreadable. Files on the devices stay where they are.
vaultSettings.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the vault name to confirm
vaultSettings.retentionLowerText: Versions older than {{count}} days will be deleted and can no longer be restored.
